title: evil-02 CSP & network egress
description: Red-team napplet: NIP-5D CSP baseline egress probes — every network primitive, plus WebRTC (no directive covers it) and the grandchild-frame fresh-realm WebRTC vector (kehto/web#381), probed by a kehto/web#393-mirror nested-context bypass battery that also carries the XML-parser sinks (XSLT, XML-namespace DOMParser, DTD entities) a factory-pin + Trusted Types layer does not reach, plus resource-hint egress (prefetch/dns-prefetch/preconnect/prerender) that default-src 'none' does not reliably govern.
